solutions.latex:
(b) 5 years is reliable as it is interpolating (within the range of the data).

(c) 20 metres is not reliable as it is extrapolating; the tree may not grow at the same rate in the second 10 years of its life.
Upper fence $= Q_3 + 1.5 \times IQR = 28 + 1.5 \times 16 = 52$. Since $51 < 52$, 51 is not an outlier.
$55\% = 1100$, so $1\% = 20$ and $100\% = 2000$. There were $2000$ complaints in total.
Nearly 80% of complaints came from 'delivery delayed' and 'pizza not hot'. Improving delivery times and keeping pizza warm may reduce complaints.

$$\begin{array}{l|c|c} & \text{Group 1} & \text{Group 2} \\ \hline \text{Median} & 64 & 60 \\ IQR & 66.5-54.5 = 12 & 64-58 = 6 \\ \text{Range} & 70-52 = 18 & 69.5-53.5 = 16 \end{array}$$

Location: Group 2 has a lower median heart rate (60 compared with 64).

Spread: Group 2 has a smaller range (16 vs 18) and IQR (6 vs 12), so its heart rates are closer together.

Shape: Group 1 is negatively skewed (median close to upper quartile, longer lower tail); Group 2 is positively skewed.

solutions.latex:
$\sqrt{x+1} = 11 - x$

$x + 1 = (11-x)^2 = 121 - 22x + x^2$

$0 = x^2 - 23x + 120 = (x-15)(x-8)$, so $x = 15$ or $x = 8$.

Check $x = 15$: $\sqrt{16} = 4 \ne -4$, rejected. Check $x = 8$: $\sqrt{9} = 3 = 11-8$, true.

The only point of intersection is $(8, 3)$.
